authority.note: Sense B preregister only. Historical F-019…F-027/F-035/F-070 are evidence, not economic closure for this instance. economic_claims_allowed remains false until mt00==PASS and mt01_matrix_coverage==COMPLETE. Sealing this JSON grants comparability, never promotion, never fusion weight, never Ultron change, never ACTIVE_VERSION control.

population.inclusion_rule: Independent unit = one CRT TRADE_OPENED event produced by src/config_layer/crt_engine_v2.py on ACTIVE_VERSION=v2_multi_2026_04 (F-074 directional displacement in path). Count the journaled trade, not SWEEP/DISPLACEMENT/RETEST detections. Path: BacktestRunner / xauusd excel tracer that calls CRTEngine.process_candle then EngineRunner when engine_gate_enabled=true.
population.exclusion_rule: Exclude FILTER_REJECTED, inverted-SL EXECUTION with no TRADE_OPENED, SHADOW_PENDING-only visits, S1–S10 StrategyOrchestrator consensus rows (weight_strategy_consensus default 0; not this population). Exclude opportunities.jsonl detections (F-022). Holiday/gap: do NOT apply the FX holiday-gap REJECT that F-035 used to drop XAUUSD; keep MT5 missing-bar gaps as absent rows and record drop count in the fingerprint.

features.point_in_time_rule: Decision time t = TRADE_OPENED bar. Features are whatever production FeaturePipeline emits on ACTIVE_VERSION (normalization_basis=atr_relative, session_timestamp_basis=broker_local, swing_window as configured). F-051 centered-swing leak and F-066 broker-clock session mislabel are DECLARED residuals of this object — they are part of what is being measured, not silently cleaned. No extra global-rank. No future bars beyond what production already publishes.

labels.y_definition: y_R = net R-multiple of the TRADE_OPENED unit under exit_model_id=EX-CRT-SB-INTRABAR-V1 and cost_model_id=CM-XAUUSD-LEGACY-12BPS-UNCALIBRATED. y_win = 1 if y_R>0 else 0. Never use opportunities.outcome or trade.rr_achieved from the F-022 stream as y.
labels.sign_convention: LONG positive when price rises; SHORT positive when price falls; R = pnl / initial_risk after declared costs

components.name: round_trip
components.bps_or_formula: 12 bps round-trip LEGACY constant (F-025/F-035 provenance). NOT a calibrated XAUUSD spread. Metals profile calibration is PENDING. Net figures under this model are DIAGNOSTIC until a derived_per_instrument.v1 k is sealed.

exits.intrabar_rule: forward_walk.intrabar_fixed: on each M15 bar, SL is tested before TP (conservative same-bar). Partial TP at tp1 then remainder at tp2 or SL. No stream-outcome substitution.

splits.embargo: 96 M15 bars (24h) between last train decision and first test decision
splits.purge: drop train trades whose exit horizon overlaps the test start timestamp
splits.oos_fraction_or_dates: last 20% of TRADE_OPENED events by entry_ts after inclusion; exact dates locked in split_manifest at run

metrics.success_gate: OOS n>=30 AND net_expectancy_R>0 AND profit_factor>1 AND max_drawdown_R within G001 10% band AND beats pre-registered controls (random_entry, long_only). Diagnostic only until mt00+mt01 seal. Does NOT promote.
metrics.kill_criteria: KILL economic claim if: (1) n<30 (INSUFFICIENT, not harmful); (2) y used stream outcome; (3) detections counted as trades; (4) gate-OFF CRT-only path claimed as fusion; (5) 12bps treated as calibrated metals cost; (6) session utc_corrected claimed as production filter. New thesis requires a new MC id.

modules_explicitly_out_of_path: mt5_analytics/* (broker honesty sidecar, not this entry generator)

prohibited_substitutions.forbidden: Treat pipeline retest_depth as FM-027 or utc_corrected session as the production filter
Ignore F-051 centered-swing leak while claiming PIT-clean labels
Treat 12bps as a calibrated XAUUSD cost or report only gross as success
Substitute stream outcome or close-only for forward_walk.intrabar_fixed
Train labels whose horizon overlaps OOS
p-value or n_detections as edge; n<30 as harmful rather than insufficient
Claim gate-OFF CRT-only as the fusion spine (F-037/F-058)
Count StrategyOrchestrator, TradeNet, BitNet, live hook, or oss_lab as this measured path

open_risks_non_blocking: F-066 broker_local session mislabel is part of the measured production object
F-051 centered-swing leak is part of the measured production object
n may be <30 on available XAUUSD windows (INSUFFICIENT, not harmful)
27 E-MT-01 probes are not implemented in this repo (0/27)
